Hosea yere ne ne mma
1 # Yes 1.1; 2 Ah 14.23; Amos 1.1 AWURADE asɛm a ɛbaa Beeri ba Hosea nkyɛn Yuda ahemfo Usia, Yotam, Ahas ne Hesekia berɛ soɔ, ne Israelhene Yeroboam a ɔyɛ Yoas ba berɛ soɔ nie.
2 # Hos 3.1 Mfitiaseɛ a AWURADE ne Hosea kasaeɛ no, AWURADE ka kyerɛɛ Hosea sɛ: Kɔ na kɔfa ɔbaa dwamamfoɔ ne adwamammɔ mma, na adwaman na asase no afiri AWURADE akyire rebɔ. 3Na ɔkɔ kɔfaa Diblaim babaa Gomer, na ɔnyinsɛnee, na ɔwoo ɔbabanin maa no.
4 # 2 Ah 10.30 Na AWURADE ka kyerɛɛ no sɛ: To no din sɛ Yesreel, na aka kakra na mabɛtɔ Yesreel mogya so were Yehu fie, na mama Israel fie ahennie no to atwa. 5Na ɛda no mɛbubu Israel tadua, Yesreel bonhwa no mu.
6 # Hos 2.1, 23 Na ɔnyinsɛnee bio, na ɔwoo ɔbabaa; na ɔka kyerɛɛ no sɛ: To no din sɛ Lo-ruhama,#1.6 Asekyerɛ ne: Deɛ wɔanhu no mmɔbɔ na merenna so menhunu Israel fie mmɔbɔ, na meremfa menkyɛ wɔn bio. 7Na Yuda fie na mɛhu wɔn mmɔbɔ, na magye wɔn nkwa, AWURADE wɔn Nyankopɔn mu, nanso meremfa tadua ne nkrantɛ ne akodie ne apɔnkɔ ne apɔnkɔsotefoɔ so mennye wɔn.
8Na ɔtwaa Lo-Ruhama nufoɔ, na ɔnyinsɛnee, na ɔwoo ɔbabanin. 9#Hos 2.1, 23 Na ɔse: To no din sɛ Lo-ami,#1.9 Asekyerɛ ne: Ɛnyɛ me man na monyɛ me man, na me nso, merenyɛ mo Nyankopɔn.#1.9 NYANKOPƆN: Hebri Atwerɛ no nni Nyankopɔn.
10 # Gye 22.17; Rom 9.26 Nanso Israel mma dodoɔ bɛyɛ sɛ mpoano anwea a wɔnsusuo na wɔnkan no; na faako a wɔbɛka akyerɛ wɔn sɛ: Ɛnyɛ me man ne mo no, wɔbɛka akyerɛ wɔn sɛ: Nyankopɔn teasefoɔ mma. 11#Yes 11.11-13; Yer 3.18; Hes 37.22 Na Yuda mma ne Israel mma bɛbom ahyia, na wɔasi tire baako afa, na wɔaforo afiri asase no so aba. Na Yesreel da no bɛyɛ da kɛseɛ.

pageProps.chapterText:
AWURADE asɛm a ɛbaa Beeri ba Hosea nkyɛn Yuda ahemfo Usia, Yotam, Ahas ne Hesekia berɛ soɔ, ne Israelhene Yeroboam a ɔyɛ Yoas ba berɛ soɔ nie.
Mfitiaseɛ a AWURADE ne Hosea kasaeɛ no, AWURADE ka kyerɛɛ Hosea sɛ: Kɔ na kɔfa ɔbaa dwamamfoɔ ne adwamammɔ mma, na adwaman na asase no afiri AWURADE akyire rebɔ. Na ɔkɔ kɔfaa Diblaim babaa Gomer, na ɔnyinsɛnee, na ɔwoo ɔbabanin maa no.
Na AWURADE ka kyerɛɛ no sɛ: To no din sɛ Yesreel, na aka kakra na mabɛtɔ Yesreel mogya so were Yehu fie, na mama Israel fie ahennie no to atwa. Na ɛda no mɛbubu Israel tadua, Yesreel bonhwa no mu.
Na ɔnyinsɛnee bio, na ɔwoo ɔbabaa; na ɔka kyerɛɛ no sɛ: To no din sɛ Lo-ruhama, na merenna so menhunu Israel fie mmɔbɔ, na meremfa menkyɛ wɔn bio. Na Yuda fie na mɛhu wɔn mmɔbɔ, na magye wɔn nkwa, AWURADE wɔn Nyankopɔn mu, nanso meremfa tadua ne nkrantɛ ne akodie ne apɔnkɔ ne apɔnkɔsotefoɔ so mennye wɔn.
Na ɔtwaa Lo-Ruhama nufoɔ, na ɔnyinsɛnee, na ɔwoo ɔbabanin. Na ɔse: To no din sɛ Lo-ami, na monyɛ me man, na me nso, merenyɛ mo Nyankopɔn.
Nanso Israel mma dodoɔ bɛyɛ sɛ mpoano anwea a wɔnsusuo na wɔnkan no; na faako a wɔbɛka akyerɛ wɔn sɛ: Ɛnyɛ me man ne mo no, wɔbɛka akyerɛ wɔn sɛ: Nyankopɔn teasefoɔ mma. Na Yuda mma ne Israel mma bɛbom ahyia, na wɔasi tire baako afa, na wɔaforo afiri asase no so aba. Na Yesreel da no bɛyɛ da kɛseɛ.

app.t1_copy: I've bookmarked passages that are important to me. I've even read the whole thing through in a year thanks to the reading plans.
app.t2_copy: I love how you are able to connect with friends and the Bible reading plans are awesome. This application helps me also to stay consistent in reading because it has reminders for the plans. It also gives me another way to come closer to God. Download this and read every day!
app.t3_copy: Great app with a wide selection of Bibles to choose from. ... The audio Bibles are also wonderful and easy to understand.
app.t4_copy: Many translations and languages available, and many that can be downloaded to read offline. Many useful features, such as the ability to make notes and bookmarks.
app.t5_copy: I love how it has a lot of versions and that there are verses of the day, devotions, plans and community. Thanks for this free app. :)
app.t6_copy: Great because there are many different versions and I could download multiple versions for offline reading. I'm able to listen to this app.
app.t7_copy: Helps me to read the bible more. Love the search and share features and the variety of ways to share. Also like the audio versions.
app.t8_copy: This is a great tool for studying from multiple translations. It's also convenient for listening to the bible when you're driving.
app.t9_copy: This is the best bible app out there. It has the word in different languages and versions for online and offline use. It has devotionals for everything you could think of. You can connect with others and ultimately learn about God and his Word.
